newsitem.title: USA: Individual names Michael Kolowic chairman.
newsitem.headline: Individual names Michael Kolowic chairman.

text.p: Individual Inc said Thursday that Michael Kolowich, president and chief executive officer, has also been namded chairman of the board.
He replaces former Chairman Andy Devereaux, who will continue as an active member on the board of directors.

Prior to joining Individual in September 1996, Kolowich was president and founder of AT&T Corp's AT&T New Media Services, where he led the development of information services for business professionals.

Individual is a provider of electronic personalized business information services. Through its exclusive information retrieval, filtering, and delivery technologies, Individual brings targeted business news, information, and advertising to 560,000 readers.
